description: Create a Gridline account and API key for the user with no browser. Before calling it, show the user the terms of use, the job terms and the privacy policy (call with accept_terms false to get their links) and get their yes: accept_terms true accepts them on the user's behalf. The key is saved privately on this machine (the file gridline login uses) and never shown. Free. For an existing account use login instead.

accept_terms.description: True only after the user read the terms and said yes.

name: signup
title: Create a Gridline account
